name: FortiGate — Horizontal Network Sweep (Host Discovery)
description:
Attacker objective
Enumerate live internal hosts (a ping/connection sweep) to build a lateral-movement target list.

Attack logic
A source generating denied connections to a large number of distinct internal hosts in a short window is sweeping. This is distinct from a vertical port scan (many ports, few hosts). Known infrastructure, resolvers and proxies are excluded.

Why this detection works
Counting distinct denied destination hosts per source isolates horizontal discovery.

False positives
Monitoring/discovery tooling; a busy gateway not yet excluded.

Tuning
Raise the threshold or add infrastructure to the exclusion.

Required telemetry
FortiGate traffic logs (source.ip, destination.ip, action).
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. source.ip sweeping many hosts (denied) indicates reconnaissance.
2. Correlate with the port-scan / lateral-movement rules on the same source.
false_positives: Monitoring/discovery tooling; a busy gateway not yet excluded.
query: fortinet.firewall.srccountry:"Reserved" and fortinet.firewall.action:"deny" and not source.ip:("192.168.166.1" or "192.168.25.1" or "192.168.25.2" or "172.17.25.1" or "192.168.112.222" or "192.168.112.223" or "192.168.215.109" or "192.168.220.1")
